_comment: CI-only overlay: real Developer ID signing identity. Layered on top of tauri.bundle.conf.json in the macOS release legs (see .github/workflows/release.yml) so notarized release builds are signed with a real cert, while the base tauri.conf.json keeps signingIdentity '-' (ad-hoc) for local `tauri dev` / build_desktop.sh. The identity string is not a secret (it ships embedded in every signed binary); the .p12, its password, and the notarization API key are GitHub Actions secrets.
